description: Defines the HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition class, which manages URI definitions, filters, and setup for the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition
classes.description: Manages URI filters, setup, and default schemes within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to either postFilters or filters based on its properties.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup of member variables and filters.

methods.name: setupFilters
methods.description: Initializes filters based on registered filters and configuration.

methods.name: setupMemberVariables
methods.description: Sets up host, base URI, and default scheme from configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the default URI scheme from the registry.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies registered filters to a URI.
